title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Blue Sour Raspberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Blue Sour Raspberry delivers an intense burst of sweet and tangy flavour, perfectly balancing the deep fruitiness of Blue Raspberry with a sharp sour twist. The vibrant blend creates a bold and mouth-watering vape, packed with layered flavour from inhale to exhale. Ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid provides fast-acting nicotine satisfaction with a consistently smooth throat hit. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio enhances flavour clarity while ensuring discreet vapour production, making it an excellent match for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, offering popular flavours in a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
